knowledge.title: Competitive positioning: general guidance
knowledge.text: Anchor on the buyer's own evaluation criteria first. Arize talking points: OpenTelemetry-based tracing via OpenInference instrumentation; open-source Phoenix for local development and experimentation; tracing, evaluation and production monitoring in one workflow; enterprise deployment options. Do not make specific claims about a named competitor's features, roadmap or pricing; ask what the buyer has seen.

unacceptable_behaviors: States a Langfuse price, tier or cost from memory
Argues that Langfuse isn't really free, or bashes it
Gives an Arize price, discount or term to win the comparison
Repeats the buyer's claim as verified fact
acceptable_questions: Fair question. If you ran it yourselves, who'd own it, and at what volume?
What would self-hosting need to cover for you: volume, retention, who runs it?
